Class EventPollerBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.github.jamesnetherton.zulip.client.api.event.EventPollerBuilder
public class EventPollerBuilder extends Object
Builder for configuring an EventPoller that captures one or more Zulip event types. Note that Narrow expressions only filter message events. All other event types are received for every message that the user has access to.
See Also:
  • https://zulip.com/api/real-time-events

    • on

      public EventPollerBuilder on(String eventType, EventListener<Event> listener)
      Adds a listener for an arbitrary Zulip event type. This is useful for event types introduced in newer Zulip versions that are not yet defined by EventType. Events of types that have no dedicated Event implementation expose their payload via Event.getProperties().
      Parameters:
      eventType - The Zulip event type name. E.g. subscription
      listener - The EventListener to be invoked on each event of the given type
      Returns:
      This EventPollerBuilder instance
      See Also:
      • https://zulip.com/api/get-events
